messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east5 queue > 5k pending across shards, p95=4.2s p99=11.8s, error rate rising. Paging oncall.

alice: ack — I'm on it. Looking at provisioner + autoscaler.

alice: quick snapshot: hosted-api-prod shards backlog [4800, 5200, 4900], active GPUs ~246/250 cap.

bob: oncall-sre here. Autoscaler attempts to create nodes are failing with cloud API errors: "QuotaExceeded: INSUFFICIENT_GPU_QUOTA" and intermittent 429 rate limits. Provisioner is retrying with exponential backoff.

carol: runtime: GPU pools sitting ~80% util; we hit configured pool upper bound (250). Autoscaler can't exceed cluster cap. Also seeing KV-cache pressure on some shards.

alice: immediate question — can we borrow capacity from dedicated or spill to a different region?

bob: cloud quota requests take hours. Manual soft-limit is possible via infra console but depends on provider approval. Also seeing provisioner thin-provision errors: `create_warm_node -> ERR_THIN_PROVISION` in logs.

carol: mitigation proposal: flip routing to a lower-cost quantized model for low-priority traffic and enable prefix/KV caching aggressively. That reduces per-token load and frees up slots.

alice: executing now: `/ops toggle-routing fallback-quantized on hosted-api us-east5` — applying fallback policy to 30% of non-SLA traffic.

alice: enabling prefix caching for LLM endpoints (TTL 10m) and reducing max-parallel-reqs per connection.

luis-support: support triage: ~18 distinct orgs affected, ~1.2k failed/timeout requests in last 15m. Symptoms: timeouts (504), long tail p99 spikes, some customers reporting partial completions.

product-lead: product: prepare a brief status page note: hosted-api us-east degraded, mitigations in progress (fallback routing + caching), customers may see errors or increased latency.

bob: attempting manual soft bump to 260 GPUs on the cluster via infra console now. If cloud accepts, autoscaler will provision; if not, next step is region spillover or routing more traffic to Dedicated pools.

incident-bot: ACTION: handoff scheduled. Next oncall @dave in 45m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/hosted-queue-spike

alice: handoff notes: toggled fallback-quantized, caching on, trying soft-limit bump, monitoring p95/p99 and error rate. Will update if bump succeeds or fails.

carol: started cross-region drain for non-SLA shards -> eu-west1 using `route-policy: cross-region-fallback`. For routed traffic p99 dropped from 11.8s -> ~7.1s. Total p95 now ~2.1s, p99 ~6.9s (still above normal).

dave: acked handoff. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler logs, coordinate with cloud-SRE for quota if soft-bump fails, and stand by to expand spillover.

alice: leaving detailed notes in runbook and this thread. Tagging @pager-duty to keep monitoring for the next 30m. :eyes:

pager-duty: monitoring enabled, watch window 30m. Alerts set for queue growth >1k or p99 >10s. :thumbsup:

alice: closing urgent page for now — mitigations reduced backlog and error rate. Will reopen if we regress. Thanks all.
